name: autovacuum_max_workers
description: Limits the number of concurrently running autovacuum worker processes.
symptoms: Query performance degradation due to stale statistics
Delayed vacuuming under high write load
tuning_tips: Set to (number of CPU cores - 1) for write-heavy workloads; avoid exceeding available I/O and memory capacity per worker. Monitor bloat and pg_stat_progress_vacuum to validate effectiveness.
